==Acquisition==
* [[Kurzick Bureaucrat]] ([[House zu Heltzer]] and [[Kurzick]]-allied [[guild hall]]s)
* [[Luxon Scavenger]] ([[Cavalon]] and [[Luxon]]-allied guild halls)

==Notes==
*After reaching the first [[allegiance rank]], Kurzick/Luxon Supporter, [[level]] 20 [[character]]s may learn this skill from a Kurzick Bureaucrat or Luxon Scavenger for 3,000 faction.
*The [[skill icon]] for the Kurzick version is on top, and the icon for the Luxon version is on the bottom.
*This skill triggers itself when it ends.
*[[Pious Renewal]] synergizes with this skill because of its "recharge on end" effect.

==Trivia==
*The [[scythe]] in the Kurzick skill icon appears to be a [[Briarwood Scythe]]. 
* The [[functionality]] of this skill has changed since its introduction; see its [[Aura of Holy Might/Skill history|skill history]] for details.
